ThingDef.label: god core
ThingDef.description: The God Core implant. An ultimate enhancement that grants near-divine capabilities, including practically unlimited movement and manipulation speed, along with near-invulnerability to damage.

ThingDef.label: Limb-R-Up implant
ThingDef.description: This implant injects a biological, metal-like substance that fills the organ it is installed in, causing the organ to grow more powerful and efficient.

ThingDef.label: speedrun protocol chip implant
ThingDef.description: An incredibly powerful implant that provides pure caffeine and energy into the veins of users, doubling their speed and manipulation and even increasing their learning rate.

ThingDef.label: Econo-Save CoolOff™
ThingDef.description: This implant injects a type of liquid that can easily be cooled down, allowing soldiers to survive burning temperatures without extra protection.

ThingDef.label: junkers cooling implant
ThingDef.description: This implant was designed to keep soldiers cool in scorching desert battlegrounds. Unfortunately, this one has a manufacturing defect that causes it to flood the user with cooled liquid at all times, numbing their fingers and making them more susceptible to cold temperatures and frostbite.

ThingDef.label: Econo-Save Toast-E™
ThingDef.description: This implant injects a type of liquid that can easily be warmed up, allowing soldiers to survive freezing temperatures without extra protection.

ThingDef.label: junkers heater implant
ThingDef.description: This implant was designed to keep soldiers warm in freezing arctic battlegrounds, but this one has a manufacturing defect that causes it to flood the user with heated liquid at all times, making them more susceptible to high temperatures or heatstroke.

ThingDef.label: mercenary temperature implant
ThingDef.description: This all-in-one temperature implant adds a fluid into the body that can be easily heated or cooled depending on the outside temperature. Useful for fighting in hot or cold environments, and provides protection from heat damage as well.

ThingDef.label: V.O.I.D. Illuminator implant
ThingDef.description: A highly advanced implant that enhances all capabilities of the recipient, doubling their natural abilities and providing significant armour protection, designed as an attempt to counter the ruthless corporation known as V.O.I.D., in skilled hands, it might just be enough.

ThingDef.label: vitality core implant
ThingDef.description: The Vitality Core implant. A sophisticated life-support system that dramatically increases survival chances by reinforcing vital organs, enhancing metabolic processes, and strengthening the body's core functions. Adds 50 HP to each installed body part and improves all vital capacities by 50%.
